origin.basis: Hutchinson was founded in 1853 in Châlette-sur-Loing, France, and has made bicycle tires since 1890 (company history).

manufacturing.basis: Hutchinson's reference table marks every listed size as Made in France.

availability.note: Hutchinson lists dealers rather than an online price; regional retail availability was not checked in this pass.

name: Blackbird Race TLR
positioning: Hutchinson's top racing tire with the Mach Tread Ultimate compound and Ultraswift casing.
